name: Tbi Motion Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Tbi Motion Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of precision transmission components, ball screws, and linear guides for the automation industry in Taiwan, rest of Asia, Europe, and internationally. The company’s products include miniature and self-lubricating series linear guides; ball splines; miniature, finished shaft end, end-caps circulation, external circulation, and internal circulation ball screw series; rotary series ball screw and ball splines; single axis actuators; linear ball bearings, slide shafts, and slide shaft supports; fixed and floated side ball screw support units; couplings; timing belt and pulley; and bellows. It is also involved in the investment business. Tbi Motion Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
